whyBuilt.text: 360 Garage Door and More’s owned site compresses repairs, new doors, springs, and openers into one repeated service line and a photo gallery, with no differentiated service URLs. Exact-listing enrichment returned 47 written reviews, including direct completed work for Chris Keaton’s sagging-door repair, Marcie Spitzer’s new-door installation, Gen Taylor’s spring repair, and John Oliver’s opener installation. These pages separate the four evidenced search intents while keeping anecdotal speed, holiday contact, and service-overlap claims bounded.

refs.ref: Owned WordPress site has a real brand logo, a Springfield service-area map graphic, job photos, and a contact form, but almost no service-page copy. Garage door repair is mentioned only as part of one combined line (Service, Repairs, Openers & New Doors) on Home/Services/Contact. No street address, email, or hours are published. Default WordPress sample content is still live. Strongest owned visual assets are the 360 logo, a homepage service-radius map screenshot, branded-uniform photography, and a large installation-photo gallery.
